metadata.scenario: A client requests a quote for legal services related to estate planning. Category: Quote Request. Outcome: quote_provided.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret Thompson. How can I help you today? Hi Margaret, this is Betty Lou Smith. I hope you're doing well! Hi Betty, I'm doing well, thank you! How are you? I'm fine, thanks. I wanted to ask about something a bit different today. Of course! What do you need help with? Well, I’m looking for a quote for some legal services related to estate planning. I thought you might have some resources or recommendations. I can certainly point you in the right direction. Great! I’m just a bit overwhelmed with everything, so I thought I’d reach out for guidance. That’s completely understandable, Betty. Estate planning can be quite complex. Yes, it really is. I just want to make sure everything is taken care of properly. Absolutely. I recommend contacting a local attorney who specializes in estate planning. Do you have a specific attorney in mind? Yes, I know of a firm called Smith & Associates. They have a great reputation for estate planning. Could you provide me with their contact information? Sure! Their number is +13165559875. You can also visit their website for more details. Thank you! I'll give them a call. Is there anything else I should know? Just that they often offer free consultations, which is helpful for initial questions. That sounds perfect. I’ll definitely ask about that. Also, if you need any assistance with our services during this time, we’re here to help. Right, I might need some more personal care assistance as I get everything sorted. We can discuss that! Just to remind you, we provide personal care assistance for $28 to $35 per hour. That’s good to know. I appreciate you keeping me informed, Margaret. No problem, Betty! Just let us know what you decide. Will do! Thank you so much for your help today. You’re welcome! Have a great day, Betty. You too, bye! Bye!
